title: Totem Pets Fix (Punchy!)
description: This project is a fix of Totem Pets by cheetahTDs, now for Punchy! too. A Texture Pack that Make its so when you name a totem to the name of a mob in the game it will change the model to that of said mob!
body:
This project is a fix of **Totem Pets** by **cheetahTDs**. I fixed the error where dogs' and cats' models would not appear. This is just a small fix, I do not own any of the models, textures or code.

**Added compatibility with Punchy!** If you are now going to use it, I recommend, installing the previous version, since it makes the OG Totem disappear (or manually edit the position in the hand editor).

**This project still have the same dependencies as the original.**
> You need the mods CitReswen or optifine For Every version before 1.21.5 this pack 
will work for every version after 1.21.5 without these mods.

Check out the original work here: [Totem Pets](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/totem-pets).
